raw_facts.fact: Belgium host France on Monday, 28 September 2026 at 20:45 local time (18:45 UTC) at the King Baudouin Stadium in Brussels. It is matchday 2 of League A Group 1 in the 2026/27 UEFA Nations League.

France won 1-0 away to Turkey in their Nations League opener, Zinedine Zidane's first game as France coach. Kylian Mbappé scored the winner in the 55th minute, set up by Michael Olise, but hurt his left knee moments later.

Mbappé is leaving the France camp and will miss the rest of the international window, including the Belgium match. Real Madrid diagnosed an overstretching of the posterior capsule of his left knee. Zidane said: 'he is going to have to go home. We don't want to take any risks.'
Belgium won their opener 2-0 against Italy, with goals from Mika Godts and Dodi Lukebakio. It was Belgium's first clean sheet in five matches.
After matchday 1, Belgium and France both have 3 points. Belgium are 1st in the group and France 2nd.
Belgium have lost each of their last five meetings with France, a run going back to June 2015.
Belgium are unbeaten in 9 home games against all opponents since November 2024 (6 wins, 3 draws).
France have won 8 and drawn 1 of their last 9 away matches.
The all-time record, from Belgium's side, is 30 wins, 19 draws and 25 losses against France, with 160 goals scored and 128 conceded. In the last 6 meetings France won 5 and Belgium 1, with no draws.
Recent meetings include France 2-0 Belgium in the Nations League on 2024-09-09. The most recent meeting was a 3-2 France win over Belgium.
Belgium are without Leandro Trossard (heel injury). Apart from Mbappé, France have no reported absentees.

Both teams have new coaches. Mark van Bommel took over Belgium on 15 August, replacing Rudi Garcia, who had taken Belgium to the 2026 World Cup quarter-finals. Zidane replaced Didier Deschamps as France coach after 14 years, and the Belgium match is his second game in charge.
Only the result after 90 minutes plus stoppage time counts. A draw resolves both the France and Belgium questions as 'No'.

A first-round win requires more than 50% of valid votes; blank and null votes are excluded. Otherwise the top two meet in the Oct 25 runoff, and the question counts the runoff result.

Since re-election was allowed in 1997, 3 of 4 sitting presidents who ran again won: Cardoso in 1998, Lula in 2006 and Rousseff in 2014. Jair Bolsonaro lost to Lula in 2022, 50.9% to 49.1% in the runoff.

The newest item on the White House presidential actions page is the Gold Star Mother's and Family's Day proclamation of Sept 25, 2026. None of the actions listed from Sept 16–25 (including H-1B, angling, hunting and procurement orders) mentions artificial intelligence, super intelligence or renaming AI.

In his Sept 22, 2026 UN General Assembly speech, Trump said the federal government would rename AI 'super intelligence.' He said that 'from this point forward, all of United States documents' would use 'super' instead of 'artificial.'

Breaking Defense reported that Trump gave the directive verbally at the UN, citing no signed executive order or formal memo, and said 'As of yet, there is no official announcement from the White House on how this is to be implemented.'

Michael Drager, a Deputy Assistant Secretary in the State Department's international organizations bureau, sent staff an email titled 'Change in Nomenclature AI to SI.' Citing 'the president's remarks at the GA today,' it told them to replace 'Artificial Intelligence' with 'Super Intelligence' in all remarks, positions and press elements. It was an agency email, not a presidential document.

US representatives had already started using 'SI' at UN Security Council meetings. Euronews said it was unclear whether the directive applied beyond the State Department's international organizations bureau.

This explainer said no executive order or Federal Register filing had yet made the 'Super Intelligence' switch binding. It said existing federal orders and the AI Action Plan still use 'Artificial Intelligence.'

Before the speech, Trump posted a social media poll offering 'superior intelligence,' 'extreme intelligence' and 'supreme intelligence' as new names for AI. 'Super intelligence,' the name he announced, was not one of the poll options.
According to Gizmodo's headline, the White House said Trump got China's Xi Jinping to agree to call AI 'super intelligence.' Trump posted that Xi 'seemed to like' the idea.

Trump's earlier renamings in his second term included changing the Gulf of Mexico to 'Gulf of America' by executive order and renaming Lake Ontario 'Lake America' in August 2026 during a trade dispute with Canada.
Breaking Defense noted that Trump appointees have pushed earlier terminology changes, such as 'War Department' for 'Defense Department,' and that those changes have not always gained legal status.

Only a signed executive order, proclamation or presidential memorandum counts, and it must be signed by 11:59 PM ET on Sept 30, 2026. Speeches, social media posts and polls do not count. An agency-level email such as the State Department's does not count unless it is itself a presidential action.

The National reported that the East-West pipeline had restarted and was pumping at a low rate. Its only sources were unnamed Reuters sources and satellite-data analysis. The article cited no statement from Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Energy, the government or Aramco.

The Reuters story, headlined 'Saudi Arabia restarts East-West oil pipeline, to resume exports from Yanbu, sources say', credits the restart to unnamed sources. Aramco was trying to bring flow back to 4 million bpd, below the system's full capacity of 7 million bpd.

The Saudi-owned Asharq Al-Awsat also carried the restart under the headline 'Sources: Saudi Arabia Restarts East-West Oil Pipeline', so the report is again attributed to sources and not to an official announcement.
Sources said reaching about 40% of capacity would take a couple of days and a full restart would take 6 to 8 weeks. Another source put the full restart at up to six weeks.

Pumping has resumed at reduced rates, and tanker loadings at Yanbu appear to have restarted this week, but regular exports have not recovered. Two tankers due to load on September 23 had not loaded, and six more were scheduled for September 24–27.

Sources said volumes on the East-West pipeline were building but tanker loading at Yanbu was delayed. Reuters reported that Aramco told European refiners it first needed to build a 'critical mass' of crude at Yanbu.
Industrial Info Resources cited satellite imagery showing vessels loading crude at Yanbu after the pipeline attack.

The Ministry of Energy's statement on SPA was headlined 'East–West Pipeline Shut Down as a Precaution Following Multiple Attacks'. The ministry also posted it on X and said emergency teams were deployed to secure the pipeline and assess its safety.

Saudi Arabia shut the East-West crude pipeline after several drone attacks launched from Iraq hit it in the Riyadh and Medina regions. Satellite imagery and industry sources reported that 3 of its 11 pumping stations were damaged.

There is a precedent from April 2026. On April 9 the Ministry of Energy said attacks had cut about 700,000 bpd of East-West pipeline capacity, and around April 12 it announced on SPA that full pumping capacity of about 7 million bpd had been restored.

Argaam carried the April Ministry of Energy statement that the energy facilities and the East-West line had recovered and regained their operating capacity. The ministry has made such a restoration announcement at least once before.

The 1,200 km pipeline links the eastern oil fields to the Red Sea port of Yanbu and has been rerouting about 4 million bpd around the Strait of Hormuz. The Saudi Foreign Ministry said Riyadh would hold off retaliating to give Iraq's government time to stop attacks from its territory.
The US Energy Secretary said the Saudi East-West pipeline would be back in operation within days. This came from a third party (not the Saudi government) and was about the future.

The questions resolve Yes only if official Saudi government information says the pipeline is operating now; partial capacity counts. Reports from anonymous sources or third parties, satellite data, and forward-looking statements do not count. Searches through 2026-09-27 found no Saudi official statement confirming the September restart.

Figueiredo vs. Talbott is still booked for UFC 332 on October 3, 2026 in Salt Lake City and has been moved up to the co-main event. Figueiredo has defended the card against fan criticism, and no injury or withdrawal has been reported for either fighter.

UFC 332 takes place Saturday, October 3, 2026 at the Delta Center in Salt Lake City and has 13 bouts. The bantamweight co-main is Payton Talbott (11-1) vs. Deiveson Figueiredo (25-7-1). The main event is Natalia Silva vs. Wang Cong for the vacant women's flyweight title, and the main card airs on CBS/Paramount+.

Figueiredo (born December 18, 1987; age 38) is 25-7-1. He has lost 4 of his last 5 fights: a UD loss to Petr Yan (Nov 2024), a TKO loss to Cory Sandhagen from a knee injury (May 2025), a split-decision win over Montel Jackson (Oct 2025), a UD loss to Umar Nurmagomedov (Jan 2026) and a round-2 guillotine submission loss to Song Yadong (May 30, 2026).

Before that losing run, Figueiredo won 4 straight at bantamweight: Rob Font (UD, Dec 2023), Cody Garbrandt (RNC sub, Apr 2024), Marlon Vera (UD, Aug 2024), plus the Jackson win later. He is a former two-time UFC flyweight champion.

Talbott (born September 9, 1998) is 11-1. He has 7 wins by KO/TKO, 1 by submission and 3 by decision. His only loss was a unanimous decision to Raoni Barcelos in January 2025, and his last fight was a unanimous-decision win over Henry Cejudo at UFC 323 on December 6, 2025.
Talbott hasn't fought in 2026; he will have been out about 10 months by fight night. He said he has been training a lot and was 'just detoxing for a second' from public life.

This report lists Figueiredo at No. 11 in the UFC bantamweight rankings and has Talbott outside the top 15, trying to break in. Hoodline instead lists Figueiredo at #9 and Talbott at #11, so the sources disagree on rankings.

The UFC 332 main event changed after Valentina Shevchenko gave up the women's flyweight title because of back and shoulder injuries, which led to the Figueiredo–Talbott fight moving to co-main. This event is in the U.S. (Utah), and Talbott is from Nevada (Reno).

A draw or no contest resolves 50/50. If the fight is postponed by up to two weeks, the market stays open until the rescheduled fight ends. If it is cancelled or pushed back more than two weeks, the market resolves to a fair price.

UFC 332 is scheduled for October 3, 2026 at the Delta Center in Salt Lake City, Utah. The main event is Natália Silva vs. Wang Cong for the vacant UFC Women's Flyweight Championship. The card lists no replacements or changes to the main event.

The UFC announced Silva vs. Wang Cong during the UFC Paris broadcast. Champion Valentina Shevchenko withdrew from her planned fight with Silva because of a back and shoulder ligament injury expected to sideline her for about a year, and the title was vacated.

Silva's pro MMA record is 20-5-1: 5 KO, 7 submission, 7 decision and 1 DQ wins. She is 8-0 in the UFC, ranked #1 at flyweight and #4 pound-for-pound. Her last fight was a unanimous decision win over Rose Namajunas at UFC 324 on January 24, 2026.
Silva is on a 14-fight win streak. Her last three wins were over former champions Rose Namajunas, Alexa Grasso and Jessica Andrade.
Wang Cong's pro MMA record is 10-1: 2 KO, 2 submission and 6 decision wins. Her only loss was a second-round rear-naked choke against Gabriella Fernandes at UFC Fight Night 248 on November 23, 2024.

Wang Cong is 5-1 in the UFC and has won four straight, most recently beating Tracy Cortez at UFC 329 in July 2026. She won gold at the 2013 World Wushu Championships and 2014 Asian Games, and silver in amateur boxing at the 2019 World Championships.

Wang Cong knocked out Victoria Leonardo in 1:02 of round one at UFC on ESPN 62 on August 24, 2024. It is the second-fastest KO in UFC women's flyweight history and earned her a Performance of the Night bonus.
Silva's coach Carlos Costa said the team had spent months preparing for Shevchenko before the UFC told them she was out. He described the Wang fight as a matchup of the division's best strikers.
The UFC 332 main card starts Saturday, October 3, 2026 at 8pm ET on CBS and Paramount+. Silva vs. Wang is the main event, and a title fight is scheduled for five rounds.
Other main card fights are Figueiredo vs. Talbott, Green vs. Ribovics, Soldić vs. Williams and Gautier vs. Kopylov. UFC 332 is the first numbered UFC event with its main card on CBS.

In the Phillies' final-day game against the Rays, the Phillies led 4-0 at the time of the update. Schwarber had hit a two-run double at 116.8 mph but had not homered yet. The blog had no Cubs game updates.

ESPN's final-day guide said Schwarber and Crow-Armstrong were tied for the MLB home run lead. It noted that Schwarber had gone 10 games without a home run and was trying to lead MLB for the second straight season. This comes from the search summary only, because the full page did not load.

StatMuse's 2026 leaderboard, with data through Sep 26, shows Schwarber (PHI, 155 G) and Crow-Armstrong (CHC, 161 G) tied at 45 HR. Next are Pete Alonso (BAL) 43, Yordan Alvarez (HOU) 42, Junior Caminero (TB) 42, and Matt Olson, Hunter Goodman and Ben Rice at 41 each. This is one below Bleacher Report's tie at 46 and may be stale.

September 27, 2026 is the last day of the MLB regular season, and only regular-season home runs count. Most contending teams had played 161 games going into it. Phillies postseason games will not count toward the total.
The Phillies held a 1.0-game lead for the final NL Wild Card spot and would clinch with a win over Tampa Bay or a Diamondbacks loss.
Crow-Armstrong hit his 45th home run around September 20 in a Cubs win over the Reds, which tied Schwarber for the MLB lead at that point.

The question counts regular-season games only, as recorded in official league statistics. If players are exactly tied and the league does not name a single winner, the tied players each get a proportional payout rather than a full Yes.
Schwarber has led the NL in home runs twice, in 2022 and 2025.

As of September 26, 2026, the 2026 MLB stolen base leaders were Nasim Nuñez (WSH) with 49, Chandler Simpson (TBR) with 46 and Bobby Witt Jr. (KCR) with 45 in 142 games. Jazz Chisholm Jr. and Pete Crow-Armstrong were next with 41 each.

The 2026 MLB regular season runs from March 26 to September 27, 2026, so September 27 (today) is the last day of the regular season. The postseason starts September 29, and postseason steals don't count toward the question.

Witt went 2-for-4 with two runs and a stolen base in the Royals' 11-5 loss to the Guardians on September 26, which brought him to 45 steals in 628 plate appearances (.283/.361/.444, 18 HR). To tie Nuñez's 49 on the final day he would need 4 steals, and he would need 5 to pass him, assuming Nuñez doesn't add any.
The Guardians clinched the AL Central on Saturday night, September 26, against the Royals. The Royals' last regular-season game is on September 27.

Nasim Nuñez stole second and third in the seventh inning of a 4-2 Nationals win over the Tigers. That gave him 49, a new Nationals single-season record (passing CJ Abrams' 47 from 2023), and a 3-steal lead over Chandler Simpson for the MLB lead. Reports called it the Nationals' final road game.
As of September 20, 2026, Witt had 43 steals in 136 games, so he stole 2 bases over his next 6 games through September 26.

The question resolves on the highest regular-season total in official league statistics, which covers all MLB. Postseason steals are excluded, and in an exact tie where the league doesn't declare a single winner, tied players get a proportional payout.

In Datafolha's first-round poll (fieldwork Sep 22–23, 2026; 2,002 respondents; ±2 pts), Lula (PT) had 40% and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) 36%. Next were Augusto Cury 5%, Ronaldo Caiado 4%, Renan Santos 3%, Zema 1% and Samara Martins 1%, with 7% blank, null or undecided.
In the Datafolha poll a week earlier, Lula had 39% and Flávio Bolsonaro 36%. So Lula rose 1 point while Flávio stayed flat, and Datafolha called the race a technical tie.

AtlasIntel (Sep 17–22, 2026; 5,015 interviews; ±1 pt; TSE BR-04739/2026) had Lula at 46.3% of valid votes and Flávio Bolsonaro at 43.9% in the first round. Valid votes are the measure the TSE uses. In AtlasIntel's runoff simulation, Lula led by 0.4 points.

Quaest (Sep 17–20, 2026; 2,004 voters; ±2 pts) had Lula at 37% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 33% in the first round, followed by Cury 6%, Caiado 4% and Renan Santos 3%. Blank, null or no vote was 7% and undecided 8%. In the runoff, Flávio led Lula 42% to 41%.

raw_facts.source: Wikipedia (Opinion polling for the 2026 Brazilian presidential election)
raw_facts.fact: Other late-September first-round polls, Lula vs. Flávio: PoderData (Sep 20–23) 41% vs 39%; Real Time (Sep 19–23) 41% vs 37%; Nexus (Sep 18–20) 40% vs 37%; Palver (Sep 20–23) tied at 43% each.

raw_facts.source: Wikipedia (Opinion polling for the 2026 Brazilian presidential election)
raw_facts.fact: The Futura poll (Sep 18–24, 2026) had Flávio Bolsonaro ahead in the first round, 40.4% to Lula's 38.4%. It is the only late-September poll listed with Flávio leading.
In the 2022 first round, Lula won 48.43% of valid votes and Jair Bolsonaro 43.20%, a 5.23-point gap. Polls published Sep 14–21, 2022 had shown Lula leading by 8 to 16 points.

In 2022, polls underestimated Bolsonaro by more than their margins of error. On election eve, Datafolha had Lula at 50% of valid votes and Bolsonaro at 36% of total votes. Mid-September 2022 polls had Bolsonaro at 31–34%, but he got 43.20% of valid votes.

The TSE counts first-round results as valid votes, which exclude blank and spoiled ballots. Poll figures for total votes, which include blank, null and undecided responses, are therefore lower than valid-vote shares.
The first round is on October 4, 2026, one week from today. If no candidate gets a majority of valid votes, a runoff between the top two follows later in October.
Pablo Marçal's PRTB candidacy was rejected, and Leonardo Avalanche (PRTB) replaced him. The Sep 17–20 Quaest poll was the first to include Avalanche, who registered 0%.
In Datafolha's March 2026 poll, Lula led every first-round scenario. Rejection rates were 46% for Lula and 45% for Flávio Bolsonaro, and the runoff stood at Lula 46%, Flávio 43%.

September polls disagree widely. Channel 14 has Likud 32, Yashar 22 and the right-wing bloc at 63. i24NEWS has Likud 27, Yashar 22 and the coalition at 60. Maariv has Yashar 22, Likud 18, coalition 49 and Zionist opposition 55. N12 has Yashar 23, Likud 20, coalition 50 and opposition 66 (54 Zionist + 12 Arab). Channel 13 has Yashar 22, Likud 18, opposition 52 and coalition 51.
Averaged across the polls, Likud has 23 seats, Eisenkot's Yashar 22.2, Bennett–Lapid's B'Yachad 10.6 and the Arab parties 12.4. Likud's figure ranges from 18 to 32 seats depending on the pollster.

The Channel 13 poll gave Eisenkot's bloc 52 seats and Netanyahu's bloc 51. Neither reaches the 61 needed to govern. Hendel's Reservists party crossed the threshold with 4 seats for the first time in Channel 13 polling.

In an average of mainstream polls, Netanyahu's bloc (including Winter) is at 53.6 seats and the Zionist opposition bloc at 53.4. The non-Arab opposition cannot reach a majority without the Arab parties, which win about 12 seats.

On September 26, 2026, the opposition leaders signed a declaration of principles to cooperate in the run-up to the October 27 election. The signers were Gadi Eisenkot (Yashar), Avigdor Liberman (Yisrael Beiteinu), Yair Golan (The Democrats), and Naftali Bennett and Yair Lapid (Together).

President Herzog said that if neither bloc reaches 61 seats he will 'do everything so that there will not be repeat elections,' and he raised unity or rotation governments as options. He also suggested the Netanyahu pardon question could come into compromise talks. Netanyahu's trial is ongoing, and he has reportedly not answered Herzog's proposal to mediate a plea deal.

Haredi parties are reportedly preparing a possible shift in strategy after the election. They may not recommend any prime minister candidate at first and may stay outside the new coalition until the draft-law crisis is resolved.

Eisenkot says the Jewish opposition parties (Yashar, Beyahad, Yisrael Beiteinu, Democrats) will win 61 or more seats without Arab parties. No mainstream poll has shown either bloc at 61. Bennett–Lapid and Liberman have ruled out Arab parties in a future coalition, and Netanyahu's campaign attacks Eisenkot over possible reliance on Arab parties.

The Knesset dissolved on July 17, 2026, and election day is October 27, 2026. Diplomatic voting is on October 20, and official results are confirmed on November 4, 2026. Candidate lists were due September 8, and the electoral threshold is 3.25%.

The question resolves only when a prime minister is formally sworn in after the 2026 election. A caretaker prime minister, including Netanyahu staying on as interim PM, does not count. The questions close on October 27, 2026, which is election day and comes before any government can be sworn in.

Recent gaps from election to swearing-in: 404 days from April 2019 to May 14, 2020, spanning three elections; about 81 days after March 23, 2021 (Bennett–Lapid government sworn in June 13, 2021); about 58 days after November 1, 2022 (Netanyahu sworn in December 29, 2022).

Of the five elections from April 2019 to November 2022, 3 led to a sworn-in government (2020 Netanyahu–Gantz rotation, 2021 Bennett–Lapid, 2022 Netanyahu). The April 2019 and September 2019 elections produced no government. Netanyahu became PM after 2 of those 3 formations.

King Green vs. Esteban Ribovics was announced on September 6, 2026. It is a three-round lightweight bout at UFC 332 on October 3, 2026, at the Delta Center in Salt Lake City. The card is headlined by Natalia Silva vs. Wang Cong for the vacant women's flyweight title.

King Green's record is 36-17-1 (1 NC). He was born September 9, 1986, which makes him 40 on fight night, and his reach is 71 inches. His page still lists the Ribovics fight on October 3, 2026, at UFC 332.

Esteban Ribovics's record is 16-3. He was born April 27, 1996 (age 30), stands 5'10" and has a 69-inch reach. He has three UFC Fight of the Night bonuses and is still listed as facing King Green on October 3, 2026, at UFC 332.

Green is on a four-fight win streak: split decision over Lance Gibson Jr. (Dec 13, 2025), TKO of Daniel Zellhuber in round 2 (Feb 28, 2026), rear-naked choke of Jeremy Stephens in round 1 (May 9, 2026), and TKO of Terrance McKinney in round 1 (July 11, 2026).

Before the current streak, Green went 1-3 in four fights. He lost to Jalin Turner by KO in round 1 (Dec 2023), beat Jim Miller by unanimous decision (Apr 2024), lost to Paddy Pimblett by technical submission in round 1 (Jul 2024) and lost to Maurício Ruffy by spinning wheel kick KO in round 1 (Mar 2025). All three losses were first-round stoppages.
At UFC 330 in Philadelphia on August 15, 2026, Ribovics beat Edson Barboza by TKO at 1:32 of round 2. Barboza retired after the fight.
Ribovics's win over Barboza came after he was submitted by Mateusz Gamrot earlier in 2026. The report says Green could be in line for a top-15 ranking if he beats Ribovics.

The two have one opponent in common, Daniel Zellhuber. Ribovics beat him by split decision at UFC 306 in the 2024 Fight of the Year, and Green stopped him by TKO in round 2 in February 2026. Ribovics lost his UFC debut to Loik Radzhabov in March 2023.
Green's win over Gibson Jr. was a split decision (29-28, 28-29, 29-28) against a short-notice newcomer who came in at 9-1. It ended a two-fight losing streak.
UFC 332 is still on for October 3, 2026, with broadcast plans announced September 25. No withdrawal or change to the Green–Ribovics bout was found in the reports checked.

The market resolves Yes only if Green wins. A draw or no contest resolves 50/50. If the fight is postponed by up to two weeks the market stays open; if it is cancelled or moved more than two weeks out, it resolves at a fair price.
